## 1. Verdict
Genuine fuzz corpus member: byte-exact equal to `canonical/out2.srt` except offset 24, which
is `0xBA = ':' (0x3A) XOR 0x80` (python3: `equal-except-24: True, xor24: 0x80`) — the "flip2"
series is a bit-7 flip at 8-byte-stride offsets, matching "bit flips at 8/24-byte strides"
(srt_fuzz_survival.rs:21-22). The flip lands inside cue 1's END timestamp ("00:00" 0xBA
"04,000"), so the first timing line is unparseable. Parsed by me through the real parser
(probe_srt): cue 1 dropped with `BadTimestamp @line 2`, cues 2–3 survive with exact times
([5_500_000, 9_250_000], [62_030_000, 62_050_000] µs), Windows-1252 fallback recorded once.
Exactly the damage-tolerant behavior the survival AC pins.
